tasks.build:all: deno task build:release && deno task build:ffi && deno task build:napi && deno task build:wasm
tasks.build:wasm: deno task build:wasm:deno && deno task build:wasm:web && deno task build:wasm:node
tasks.dev: cargo watch -x 'check --workspace' -x 'test --workspace' || echo '⚠️  cargo-watch not installed. Run: cargo install cargo-watch'
tasks.check: deno task typecheck && deno task test && deno task lint && deno fmt --check
tasks.bench: deno task build:ffi && deno task build:wasm:deno && deno task bench:run
tasks.corpus:compare: deno task build:ffi && deno task corpus:compare:run
tasks.publish:npm:build: wasm-pack build crates/tsv_wasm --target bundler --release --scope fuzdev --out-dir pkg/npm && cp LICENSE crates/tsv_wasm/pkg/npm/LICENSE && deno run --allow-read --allow-write=crates/tsv_wasm/pkg/npm/package.json scripts/publish_patch_npm.ts
tasks.publish:npm: deno task publish:npm:build && cd crates/tsv_wasm/pkg/npm && npm publish --access public
tasks.publish:jsr: deno task publish:jsr:sync-version && deno task build:wasm:deno && cd crates/tsv_wasm && deno publish
tasks.publish: deno task publish:npm && deno task publish:jsr
